title: Indian police rescue 164 foreign nationals from alleged cyber fraud operation near Delhi
date_note: AFP (Gulf News, Arab News) says police issued the statement late on Thursday 26 November; the Peoples Gazette says Friday 27 November. The earlier day is used.
geo_basis: Peoples Gazette places the operation in Noida, a suburb of New Delhi.
summary: Indian police said they rescued 164 foreign nationals, 92 Indonesians and 72 Malaysians, from a cyber fraud operation in a suburb of Delhi, according to AFP (Gulf News, Arab News) and Reuters (Oman Observer). AFP says police allege they were confined and compelled to take part in cyber fraud. The Peoples Gazette reports one Malaysian national was arrested and a wider network is being investigated.
plain: Police in India say they rescued 164 foreigners, 92 Indonesians and 72 Malaysians, who were allegedly forced into online fraud near Delhi. One Malaysian was reported arrested.
exec: Police report a forced-labour online fraud operation near Delhi, with 164 people rescued; a wider network is under investigation, per the Peoples Gazette.

sources.name: Gulf News (AFP): India busts scam network, rescues 164 trafficked foreigners
Arab News (AFP): Indian police in rare rescue of foreigners trafficked for cyber fraud
Oman Observer: India rescues dozens from cyber fraud
Peoples Gazette: India rescues 164 Indonesians, Malaysians from cyberfraud network

evidence.quote: Indian police have rescued 164 foreign nationals allegedly trafficked to the country
The victims comprised 92 Indonesians and 72 Malaysians
A total of 92 Indonesians and 72 Malaysians were rescued, Delhi police said.
Indian police said they had rescued 164 foreign nationals

validation.note: Gulf News and Arab News (both AFP, one wire) and Oman Observer (Reuters) report the rescue and the 92 and 72 figures from the police statement; the Peoples Gazette adds the arrest.

review.note: date (AFP: statement late Thursday 26 Nov, not 27), wording stronger than source (illegally confined), added Arab News AFP source; figures checked
